# Modeline

> Modeline is an Algerian e-commerce store selling handmade traditional
> Algerian clothing and accessories (qaftan, burnous, haik, and related
> heritage pieces), shipped across Algeria with cash-on-delivery.

## Pages

- [Home](https://modeline.store/): brand story, featured products, trust signals.
- [Shop](https://modeline.store/shop.html): full product catalog with filtering and sorting.
- [About](https://modeline.store/about.html): brand story and customer reviews.
- [Contact](https://modeline.store/contact.html): contact information and support.
- [Cart](https://modeline.store/cart.html): shopping cart and checkout.

## Notes

- Product pages live at `https://modeline.store/product/<id>/` and include
  structured Open Graph and product metadata (price, availability, images).
- All content is in Arabic (ar-DZ).
